highlights: Control your computer from the phone: open the server menu and tap Control computer to see its screen and use it like a trackpad.
Type @ in a chat to tag one of the agent's browser tabs or side threads. The host needs OpenBot 0.62.0 or later.
A new Library in the server drawer shows every picture and file from the chats of a server.
Talk with an agent by GPT live voice, or dictate on the phone with Parakeet Unified or Qwen3-ASR in 30 languages.
Sign in with your company account, and connect GitLab, Omnisend and ElevenLabs from the Apps marketplace.
